descripcion_geo: The main river in the land of Israel, it rises in Hermon and flows into the Dead Sea, descending 400 m below sea level.
importancia_estrategica: Natural border and geographical axis of the promised land.

historias.descripcion: John baptizes in the Jordan at 'Betabara'; Multitudes come to the baptism of repentance.
Jesus is baptized by Juan; The Spirit descends like a dove and the Father's voice proclaims him beloved Son.
John the Baptist baptized in Aenon, near Salim, because there was a lot of water.

personajes.descripcion: He made the Jordan the scene of his ministry of baptism and proclamation.
He received baptism from John in the Jordan, inaugurating his public ministry.
He descended on Jesus at the baptism in the Jordan like a dove.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: The Jordan is a sacred border: with Joshua the people crossed to enter Canaan; with John the Baptist it became the place of the new beginning.

judaismo.descripcion: The crossing of the Jordan with Joshua marked the entry into the promised land (Jos 3-4); Elijah and Elisha also miraculously crossed it (2 Kgs 2:8).
judaismo.significado_teologico: The crossing of the Jordan with Joshua marked the entry into the promised land (Jos 3-4); Elijah and Elisha also miraculously crossed it (2 Kgs 2:8).

cristianismo.descripcion: Jesus's baptism in the Jordan recapitulates the exodus crossing and inaugurates the new covenant.
cristianismo.significado_teologico: Jesus's baptism in the Jordan recapitulates the exodus crossing and inaugurates the new covenant.

islam.descripcion: Isa (Jesus) is considered a prophet in Islam; Baptism in the Jordan is not Islamic practice but the river is recognized as the sacred land of the prophets.
islam.significado_teologico: Isa (Jesus) is considered a prophet in Islam; Baptism in the Jordan is not Islamic practice but the river is recognized as the sacred land of the prophets.
